list.name: cliente
list.label: Cliente
list.query: SELECT concat(nombre, ' (', toString(id_cliente), ')') FROM sensores.clientes FINAL ORDER BY id_cliente
list.definition: SELECT concat(nombre, ' (', toString(id_cliente), ')') FROM sensores.clientes FINAL ORDER BY id_cliente

list.name: sensor
list.label: Sensor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT sensor FROM sensores.sensores WHERE id_cliente = ${cliente} ORDER BY sensor
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT sensor FROM sensores.sensores WHERE id_cliente = ${cliente} ORDER BY sensor

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(medido_en) AS time, sensor, avg(temperatura_c) AS temperatura
FROM sensores.lecturas
WHERE $__timeFilter(medido_en)
  AND id_cliente = ${cliente}
  AND has([${sensor:singlequote}], sensor)
GROUP BY time, sensor
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  sensor AS Sensor,
  max(medido_en) AS `Última lectura (UTC)`,
  round(argMax(temperatura_c, medido_en), 2) AS `°C`,
  round(argMax(temperatura_f, medido_en), 2) AS `°F`,
  count() AS Lecturas
FROM sensores.lecturas
WHERE id_cliente = ${cliente}
  AND has([${sensor:singlequote}], sensor)
GROUP BY sensor
ORDER BY sensor
